bibl.title: Octavian Transformed as Pharaoh and as Emperor Augustus.
bibl.seg: Erin A. Peters, Octavian Transformed as Pharaoh and as Emperor Augustus.
Renee M. Gondek & Carrie L. Sulosky Weaver (edd.), The Ancient Art of Transformation. Case studies from Mediterranean contexts (Oxford - Philadelphia, 2019) pp. 107-134, figg.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Modern study of Augustean temples in Egypt. - Spatial analysis at Karnak. - Accessibility: temple form and function. - Movement: processions and festivals. - Visibility: priests and the public in the Augustean period. - Conclusion: uniting Rome and Egypt in functioning space.
